sentences.en: I don't know how to talk to emotionally distraught people.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该如何和情绪崩溃的人交谈。

sentences.en: She held my hands and looked at me very emotionally.
sentences.zh: 她握着我的手，非常深情地看着我。

sentences.en: He may be strong physically, but he's pretty weak emotionally.
sentences.zh: 他身体上可能很强壮，但在情感上却很脆弱。
